San José State University
CS 101: Introduction to Programming
Section 02 · Fall 2026
Instructor: Dr. Rivera · Office hours: Tuesdays 1:00–2:30 PM, MQH 228

Course description
This course introduces programming in Python: variables, control flow, functions, lists, and files. Bring a laptop to every class.

Grading
Homework (8 assignments)  20%
Quizzes  10%
Essay 1  10%
Midterm exam  20%
Final project  15%
Final exam  25%
